description: This module uses the keyring Python library to set or delete passphrases for a given service and username from the OS’ native keyring.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the password should exist. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The user belonging to the service.

examples:
- name: Set a password for test/test1
  community.general.keyring:
    service: test
    username: test1
    user_password: "{{ user_password }}"
    keyring_password: "{{ keyring_password }}"

- name: Delete the password for test/test1
  community.general.keyring:
    service: test
    username: test1
    user_password: "{{ user_password }}"
    keyring_password: "{{ keyring_password }}"
    state: absent
